transport: Single JSON document after all worker threads join; any invalid index/overflow/FD/write/duplicate/actual pass-channel mismatch exits86. File starts empty and O_APPEND.
configuration: Effective library static_config emitted after threads join; pass2/one channel/1920x1080/10bit/24fps required, parent validator checks frozen policy.
scope: Search invocations, not encoded-block/pixel populations. Six wrapped existing uint64 psy terms: two fast-luma sites plus TX prediction/reconstruction and full-spatial prediction/reconstruction. Additional chroma/inter-prediction/quad/TF psy sites unobserved.
neutrality_gate: Full336 IVF equals unmodified with counters off and on, same pass1stats and all settings.
optimizer_invariant: ENTER = EARLY_RATE + EARLY_EOB + COMPLETE; GUARD <= LUMA <= ENTER; ZERO_WEIGHT <= GUARD.
term_invariant: each NONZERO <= corresponding CALL; full spatial calls paired prediction/reconstruction; TX terms paired; actual source branches retained.
skip_invariant: ZERO_CHOICE <= ZERO_COMPARE and SKIPMODE_CHOICE <= SKIPMODE_COMPARE; spatial subsets identify route flags, not proof of nonzero carried term in each candidate.
mode_invariant: INTER + INTRA = CALL; HBD/SPATIAL/SKIP/COEFF <= CALL; candidate totals >= calls. Selection can later lose partition search.
